title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty term to the loss function, which is proportional to the absolute value of the coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively selecting a simpler model.

title: Effect on Training MSE
text: Consider how adding a penalty term to the loss function might affect the model's ability to fit the training data perfectly.

title: Analyzing Training MSE with LASSO
text: When LASSO regularization is applied, the model may not fit the training data as closely as an unregularized model. What is a possible effect on the MSE on the training data?
